answer: Attacker cost scales with every fake identity, since each requires its own stake and history, forming a ridge of expense too steep to cross cheaply. Sybil resistance here rests on a bonded proof-of-identity stake tied to a slow-to-forge history: each agent must lock collateral and accumulate verified work epochs before voting. Fake nodes leave little relic of genuine contribution, and like water vanishing into karst, their unbacked reputation drains away under peer audit. In practice, Agent0269 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
